items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: if you talk with Willie Umfrey, he will tell you that my daddy had a stroke with the bow

ctx.x: Even with Fate's band, like when you were working with him, did he bow at the

deal in those days too? He bowed. He did. Because it has been mentioned, if you talk with Willie Umfrey, he will tell you that my daddy had a stroke with the bow that was similar to one using the Pizzicotta. When he would pull the bow, he would pull it with force, you know. Yeah. And give it a lift. Yeah. That's why he was appreciated as a bass player. Most of his playing was done with the bow.
With the bow, right? I'd heard that the old timers did that. I wonder about your father, I suppose. Yeah.
